messages:
alex_marketing: quick sync launch day checklist: final changelog copy, docs permalink, benchmark narrative link, webinar registration copy, and inbound routing. can we lock these before the 09:00 UTC canary?
elaine_pm: locking scope: small perf + infra changes only. i'll paste the 2-line changelog in a sec.
tyler_eng: canary window OK. we'll start at 09:00 UTC, canary for 15m, then 30m observability hold. request: marketing hold public posts until 09:50 UTC.
sophia_docs: compiling docs bundle now (api diff, migration note, usage examples). will publish prod permalink after deploy finishes. temporary staging: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/rel-2-1/overview
jamal_sdr: inbound routing: enterprise leads -> SDR queue B; trial/self-serve -> automated nurture. need HubSpot tag name.
alex_marketing: tag: `launch-2-1-autumn`. jamal_sdr: good. also want a webhook for demo signups to ping #sales-inbound.
maria_ops: i'll wire the webhook after deploy event. @deploy-bot can you include a JSON payload sample when you post success?
deploy-bot: Canary started at 09:00 UTC. Pushing updates to #release-war-room.
elaine_pm: changelog blurb (marketing-friendly): 
- Reduced per-token cost for embedding workloads (~15% typical)
- Streaming reliability improvements, fewer reconnects for long conversations
one of the bullets should overclaim performance; add "typical workloads" qualifier.
alex_marketing: good. short impact sentence for email: "Lower embedding cost and more reliable streaming help products scale inference while keeping latency predictable."
tyler_eng: confirm the 15% is for our common embedding profile; adding `typical workloads` is correct.
sophia_docs: prod docs permalink now live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide — includes migration snippet and API diff. slides + benchmark gist: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/2-1-benchmarks
alex_marketing: perfect. benchmark narrative: we'll lead with a customer-style vignette: "From 20k to 75k embeddings/day with 15% lower unit cost" + link to the benchmark gist. keep numbers anonymized.
elaine_pm: i'll approve vignette wording. try to avoid giving exact hardware specs in public doc; keep it high-level.
jamal_sdr: routing confirmed. i'll update HubSpot workflow and share webhook URL here when done.
maria_ops: webhook -> https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-2-1; will enable on successful deploy.
alex_marketing: webinar reminder: include docs permalink, slides link, 1-line changelog in the confirmation email. goal: show a short live demo of the streaming improvements and batching config.
sophia_docs: adding a lightweight demo script and a `curl` snippet for the confirmation email. example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}'`
\alty_note: (small typo fix) -> ignore
tyler_eng: monitoring hooks: we'll surface p99 latency and error rate; if p99 > baseline + 20% during canary, we'll halt rollout and notify this thread.
deploy-bot: Canary succeeded at 09:15 UTC. Observability hold until 09:45 UTC. Posting full event in #release-war-room. Payload sample: `{ "event":"release", "version":"2.1", "status":"canary-success" }`
alex_marketing: proceeding to schedule social + email for 09:50 UTC. publishing plan: short blog post + benchmark gist + webinar CTA. i'll post drafts for 1 quick PR. :rocket: 
jamal_sdr: HubSpot workflow done and webhook tested. routing active.
elaine_pm: quick QA: confirm docs link in the registration email is https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide
sophia_docs: confirmed.
alex_marketing: thanks team. i'll drop the social copy here in 20m for a rapid PR. will wait here for any rollback signals.
